recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned, low-key portrait of a smiling man in a cowboy hat, set against a dark, textured background with a vertical graphic strip on the left featuring a ghosted acoustic guitar.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright cream cowboy hat acts as the primary highlight against the dark background.
The vertical guitar strip on the left balances the right-aligned typography.
Warm amber skin tones harmonize with the gold-toned serif lettering.
Deep shadows create a sense of intimacy and focus on the subject's expression.
coreInvariants: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the face.
A vertical divider separating the instrument detail from the main portrait.
A neutral, warm color palette dominated by browns, creams, and blacks.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered-right, captured from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, wide-brimmed cowboy hat at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright hat, move down to the smiling face, then follow the diagonal of the shoulder to the text in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space on the right side provides a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black provide the background and shadow depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and off-white used for the hat and highlight areas.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-tan and amber for skin tones and text color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the highlights and the deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: No neon or vibrant primary colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic transitional serif with high stroke contrast.
letterConstructionRules: Uppercase serif for the main name with an oversized, script-like initial letter.
Wide tracking for the secondary subtitle text.
Italicized serif for the primary name to suggest elegance.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'J' is enlarged and features a decorative, sweeping tail that underlines part of the name.

composition.overlap: Slightly overlaps the subject's dark jacket

composition.relationshipToImage: Anchors the bottom of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, high-contrast serif for the name paired with a widely-spaced, minimalist serif for the title.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom line

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif feel with elegant italics.
Small-caps serif with wide presence for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a cream cowboy hat and dark jacket, smiling, lit with warm amber light from the side. On the left, include a vertical strip showing a faded, desaturated acoustic guitar neck. The background should be dark and textured.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a golden serif font in the lower right, using a large decorative initial. Place a single line of widely-spaced, small-caps text along the bottom edge in off-white.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and high-contrast?
Is the cowboy hat the brightest element?
Is the bottom text tracking extremely wide?
Is there a clear vertical division on the left side?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left guitar strip
Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: The specific facial features of the artist
Any specific brand logos on the guitar or hat
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the guitar strip doesn't distract from the main face.
Verify the 'J' or initial letter has a decorative flourish.
Confirm the color palette remains strictly warm-toned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Portrait + Vertical Instrument Strip + Golden Serif Typography + Wide-Tracked Subtitle
